"''We saved him.|Cassian Andor talking with Rylanz|}} A rebel '''pilot''' associated with the [[Axis network]] crashed in the mountains on [[Ghorman]] sometime before [[3 BBY]]. He was rescued by members of the [[Ghorman Front]]. As a result of the rescue [[Luthen Rael]] sent the Front a [[fractal radio]] in order to communicate with the group. ==Behind the scenes== The pilot was first mentioned "[[Ever Been to Ghorman?]]" an episode in the [[Andor Season 2|second season]] of the live-action series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'' which was released on [[Disney+]] on [[April 29]], [[2025]].{{SW|url=news/andor-season-2-teaser-trailer-key-art-reveal|text=First ''Andor A Star Wars Story'' Teaser Trailer and Poster Revealed}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Ever Been to Ghorman?}} {{1stm}} *{{Andor|I Have Friends Everywhere}} {{Mo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |ka=უცნობი აჯანყებული პილოტი (გორმანი) }} [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified gender]] [[Category:Individuals with he/him pronouns]] [[Category:Members of Axis network]]
